settings.hero_desc: A solid concrete cube award with crisp engraved lettering and a bold red accent, presented under a clear case. A modern, architectural take on the corporate trophy - understated, premium and fully personalised.
settings.s1_body: For brands that prefer understated over ornate, this concrete cube award is a statement in restraint. The engraving is cut directly into the concrete face, with a sharp red accent for contrast, and the whole piece sits under a clear case. Available in concrete or terrazzo finishes, it is the ideal trophy for design-led companies, architecture and innovation awards.
settings.case_body: Created as a corporate recognition award, this concrete cube gave a design-conscious company a trophy that matched its aesthetic - minimal, tactile and premium, personalised per recipient and protected under a clear case.
settings.case_quote: Exactly the understated, design-led look we wanted. Recipients love how different it feels.
settings.prov_p: Not every award needs gold and glass. A clean concrete form with precise engraving signals confidence and good taste - recognition that feels designed, not bought off a shelf.
